products.title: Products
products.description: Browse, create, and manage the products in your catalog.
products.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU, or barcode…

fields.name: Name
fields.skuHint: Stock-keeping unit. Becomes the canonical identifier.
fields.descHint: Shown on listing and product detail pages.

products.categoriesHint: Select one or more categories. Mark one as primary.
products.noCategories: No categories yet. Create categories first.
products.shareDropshipHint: Makes the product visible to other tenants for dropshipping. Does not affect the store.
products.statusHint: Change status from the row's ⋮ menu (Publish / Archive).

empty.title: No products yet
empty.body: Create the first product to start building your catalog.
empty.addFirstBody: Add your first product to start selling. Each carries its own SKU, price, stock, and image.
empty.searchBody: Nothing matches "{{term}}". Try a different term or clear the search.
empty.filterBody: No products match the current filters.

products.createDetailsDesc: Add a product to your catalog. Price and stock can be adjusted inline after creation.
products.editDetailsDesc: Update details for {{name}}. Use the inline price/stock chips to change price and stock — they emit domain events.
products.deleteFullDesc: This permanently removes {{name}} (created {{date}}). The product will no longer appear in any listing or report.
products.deleteDesc: This will permanently remove the product and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
products.changePriceDesc: Set a new base price for this product. The change takes effect immediately.
products.changePriceDomainDesc: Emits a ProductPriceChanged domain event for {{name}}.
products.adjustStockDesc: Add a positive or negative quantity adjustment. The new total will be applied immediately.
products.adjustStockDomainDesc: Add or remove units for {{name}}. Emits a ProductStockAdjusted event.
products.stockNegativeWarning: Stock cannot go negative. Maximum decrement is {{max}}.
products.createDesc: Fill in the details below. SKU is required and must be unique.
products.slugHint: Auto-derived from the name. Used in URLs.
products.descriptionHint: Shown on listing and product detail pages.

detail.descSectionDesc: Customer-facing copy shown on the product page.
detail.imagesSectionDesc: Drop more to add. Star one to make it the cover.
detail.noDescOnFile: No description on file. Customers will see a blank description on the product page until you add one.
detail.notFoundDesc: It may have been deleted, or the link may be wrong.

products.quickCreateDesc: Create the record and keep editing the product without leaving this screen.

trash.title: Deleted products
trash.restoreDesc: Do you want to restore "{{name}}"? It will become available in the catalog again.

products.defaultSkuHint: Unique identifier for the default variation. Leave blank to auto-generate as «{slug}-default».
products.publishConfirmDesc: The product will become visible in the catalog.
products.archiveConfirmDesc: The product will be hidden and cannot be purchased. It can be re-activated later.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Curate the maker imprints behind every product. Each brand carries its own slug, story, and logo.

empty.title: No brands yet
empty.body: Add your first brand to start building the catalog. Each brand carries its own slug, description, and logo.
empty.searchBody: Nothing matches "{{term}}". Try a different term or clear the search.
empty.filterBody: No brands match the current filters.

brands.deleteDesc: This permanently removes {{name}}. Products referencing this brand will need to be reassigned.
brands.createDesc: Add a brand to your catalog. The slug is generated automatically from the name.
brands.editDesc: Update details for {{name}}. The slug is re-derived from the name.
brands.slugHint: Auto-derived from the name. Used in URLs.
brands.descriptionHint: Shown on listing and product detail pages.
brands.logoHint: Optional. Public URL to the brand's logo image.
brands.descPlaceholder: Quality essentials for the modern home.

trash.title: Trash — Brands
trash.description: Deleted brands that can be restored.
trash.restoreConfirmDesc: The brand will become active and visible in the catalog again.

brands.websiteHint: Optional. Official website URL of the brand.
brands.countryHint: Optional. ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. JP, CN, CO).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Organise your products into a hierarchical category tree.

trash.title: Deleted categories
trash.restoreDesc: Do you want to restore "{{name}}"? It will become available in the catalog again.

empty.title: No categories yet
empty.body: Create categories to organise your products into a navigable hierarchy.
empty.searchBody: Nothing matches "{{term}}". Try a different term or clear the search.
empty.filterBody: No categories match the current filters.

categories.deleteDesc: This permanently removes {{name}}. Child categories and products referencing it will need to be reassigned.
categories.createDesc: Add a category to your catalog. The slug is generated automatically from the name.
categories.slugHint: Auto-derived from the name. Used in URLs.
categories.parentHint: Optional. Select a parent to make this a sub-category.
categories.deleteFullDesc: This permanently removes {{name}} (created {{date}}). Categories with child categories cannot be deleted — move or delete the children first.
categories.sortOrderHint: Position in the list. Lower = first.

variations.title: Variations
variations.createDesc: Add a SKU to the product. The SKU is unique and fixed after creation.
variations.editDesc: Update details for {{sku}}. The SKU cannot be changed.
variations.deleteDesc: Delete variation {{sku}}? The default variation cannot be deleted.

codes.title: Codes
codes.desc: Identifiers for {{sku}} (SKU, EAN, UPC, supplier code…).
codes.empty: No codes yet. Add one below.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Define attributes like Color or Size and their values to generate product variations.
attributes.createDesc: Create an attribute to classify and generate variations.
attributes.deleteDesc: Delete attribute "{{name}}" and all its values? Not allowed if it is used by any product.
attributes.usedForVariationsHint: When on, its values generate variations (WooCommerce style).
attributes.visibleHint: Show this attribute on the product page.

values.title: Values
values.empty: No values yet. Add the first one.
values.colorHint: Hex color to display (Color type only).
values.name: Value

attributes.title: Product attributes
attributes.intro: Pick attributes and their values. Mark "for variations", then generate variations automatically.
attributes.noAttributes: No attributes yet. Create them first in Catalog → Attributes.

tags.title: Tags
tags.intro: Tags like "Sale" or "New" to classify the product.

wizard.requiredStep1: Fill type, name and SKU to continue
wizard.variableOnly: Variations only apply to Variable products.
